rho_reference.ic_unpriced: not emitted (F_p additions, hash lookups, F4 symbolic work); IC S at w > 0 is a lower bound
rho_reference.order: rho_neg below both IC arms at every weight (IC lower bound > rho_neg upper bound)
rho_reference.reference: rho_e_neg (JV_RHO_NEG=1), same jv_cover process and Spec as the index calculus, after its clock
rho_reference.rho_neg_unpriced_bounds: per step: 1 lookup + 1 insert + 1 partition hash; per candidate addition: 1 canonicalisation + 1 hash + 2 coefficient updates; u_lo = 5 steps, u_hi = 3 steps + 4 group_ops (derived from emitted steps and group_ops; the binary emits no unpriced counter)
rho_reference.unit: group additions on E(F_{p^6}) per sqrt(l): IC = counted F_p muls / (c_add_E sqrt l), c_add_E = measured F_p muls of one E addition; rho = counted group operations (additions and doublings, setup included) / sqrt(l)
